lines.text: Urgent: Campus Transport and Traffic Advisory
Beginning November 6, infrastructure improvements will take place
on North Avenue. Work is scheduled from 7:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M. daily,
Mondays through Saturdays. Expect delays during the above hours,
when North Avenue will be reduced to one lane in each direction.
Students and staff are strongly encouraged to use alternative routes
or the university's expanded shuttle service.
Shuttle wait time will be decreased from 20 to 15 minutes at the
following pick-up points:
• East Hall
• West Commons
• Central Library
Parking on North Avenue will be temporarily suspended starting
on November 6. For students and staff requiring parking
accommodations, overflow lots will be available at the
Pemberton Parking Complex. Residents should expect increased
noise and dust in the vicinity.
We appreciate your understanding as the Campus Services office
strives to enhance traffic efficiency and accessibility on campus.
For updates, visit the university's infrastructure website.
